name: Eraser

icon: A pink glob exuding tiny soap bubbles.

name: See Ya

icon: Shimmering silver magnifying glass spinning slowly in place.

name: Speedy Gonzalvez

icon: A trail of dust appearing behind the Netrunner as they move.

name: Worm
text: Increases all Backdoor Checks you make by +2 as long as this Program remains Rezzed.
icon: A golden mechanical worm with neon green eyes.

name: Armor
text: Lowers all brain damage you would receive by 4, as long as this Program remains Rezzed. Only 1 copy of this Program can be running at a time. Each copy of this Program can only be used once per Netrun.
icon: Transparent golden armor worn by the Netrunner.
transcription_note: D-2: brain damage subtracts from HP and armour is ignored (the 'direct' wording, p202). The netrunning chapter (p196-p219) does not state what brain damage is applied against or what reaching 0 does; the sheet prints the rule text only.

name: Flak

name: Shield
